description.ncbi_summary: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the Kunitz family of serine protease inhibitors. The protein is a potent inhibitor specific for HGF activator and is thought to be involved in the regulation of the proteolytic activation of HGF in injured tissues. Alternative splicing results in multiple variants encoding different isoforms. [provided by RefSeq, Jul 2008].

uniprot_function.text: Inhibitor of HGFAC (PubMed:9045658). Inhibits serine protease activity of ST14/matriptase in vitro (PubMed:28710277). Inhibits serine protease activity of TMPRSS13, via the BPTI/Kunitz inhibitor 1 domain (PubMed:20977675).
